stationary_review.scope: 10Hz sampled trajectory; not a continuous stopping-distance bound or all odom callbacks

sensor_sync.policy: original scan stamp/arrival; actual odom stamp <= scan; skew <=0.05s; freshness unchanged

effective_drive_intervals.selection: adjacent actual 10Hz rows; 0<wall dt<=.35; increasing sim stamp; latest pre-start command age<=.1; all commands throughout interval DRIVE/.03/0; no future command as prior

scan_geometry_hypothesis.pairing: exact recorded prior odom, original scan header
scan_geometry_hypothesis.scope: static collision boxes and public candidate rplidar pose; no official-map, class-ID, calibration or whole-route proof
